challenge.songTitle: I Love You But I’m Lost
challenge.line: To know somebody in and out, after a while it's a real challenge
stanza: Disappointed in a lover because they're the only way
To know somebody in and out, after a while it's a real challenge
Come in here and be yourself again
I love you, but I'm not somebody who takes shots
Take your silver spoon, dig your grave
Pick your path and I'll pray
See your sunrise, loves to go down
But they never cry out loud, cry out
